title: Autonomous Factory World Generator: Concept Specification
description: Autonomous Factory World Generator — Concept Specification. Builds virtual factories with production lines, robots, equipment, sensors, and material-flow rules.
body: The Autonomous Factory World Generator (catalog entry 636, World and Environment Generators) is a proposed Signature-original capability for the JAH Network apex simulator-generator family. Builds virtual factories with production lines, robots, equipment, sensors, and material-flow rules. This concept specification states the problem it solves, the class of inputs it accepts, and the class of outputs it promises. It is designed to live in the Signature ecosystem alongside the other apex tools: it exchanges tool definitions, simulation results, and evidence packs through the shared apex registry, and every artifact it produces is expected to carry its provenance, tests, and recorded results with it. This record describes a PROPOSED capability, not a completed product. Nothing here claims the tool has been built, independently verified, or deployed. Design rule: a generated tool is NOT marked operational until it has a defined interface, a successful build, meaningful tests, and recorded results.
